corrections.find: SPS 530 para 29

An earlier version of this rule relied on that erratum and pointed to 31; corrected against the paragraph text itself.

corrections.find: SPS 530 para 30 is not the investment stress testing programme; para 31 is, confirmed by para 38's own cross-reference.
corrections.replace: SPS 530 para 29 is not the investment stress testing programme.

corrections.find: Independently verified. Citation changed to para 31 and the range restated as paras 31-38 throughout.
corrections.replace: Independently verified against the standard text. The programme is para 30 ('must have a comprehensive investment stress testing program'); para 31 sets the adverse stress scenarios. Citation corrected to para 30 and the range restated as paras 30-38. Note that para 38 cross-refers to 'paragraph 31' - that cross-reference is an erratum in the standard and must not be relied on.
corrections.why: The original correction pointed at para 31 on the strength of para 38's cross-reference, which is itself wrong.

corrections.find: The comprehensive investment stress testing programme is SPS 530 paragraph 31, not paragraph 29; SPS 530 paragraph 38 cross-refers to 'paragraph 31'.
corrections.replace: The comprehensive investment stress testing programme is SPS 530 paragraph 30, not paragraph 29 (paragraph 31 sets the adverse stress scenarios). Paragraph 38 cross-refers to 'paragraph 31', but that cross-reference is an erratum in the standard.
corrections.why: Audit-trail row asserted the wrong paragraph as verified.

corrections.find: CORRECTION: the draft cited para 29 for the stress testing programme; para 29 concerns Board justification when amending an investment strategy. The standard's own cross-reference in para 38 points to para 31.
corrections.replace: CORRECTION: the draft cited para 29 for the stress testing programme. Para 29 concerns the Board's justification for any decision to amend an investment strategy following a review. The programme obligation is at para 30; para 31 requires the adverse stress scenarios. Para 38 refers to 'the comprehensive investment stress testing program required in paragraph 31' - that internal cross-reference is an erratum in SPS 530, since the programme is required by para 30, and it should not be relied on.
corrections.why: The row justified its own correction from para 38's erratum, asserting both 30 and 31 as the programme.

corrections.find: the new annual actuarial valuation capability, the tighter response window, and decades-long deferred debt account tracking that must survive mergers and administrator changes.
corrections.replace: the new annual actuarial valuation capability and the tighter response window - noting that the deferred debt account is maintained by the Commissioner and not by the fund, so what must survive mergers and administrator changes is the trustee's own valuation and member-level reporting record, not a debt account.
corrections.why: Listed debt-account tracking as a trustee capability, inventing an obligation the law does not impose - in the disposition whose purpose is to separate genuine trustee duties from a category error.

verified_facts.fact: Subdivision 296-A of the ITAA 1997 contains only s 296-5, an objects clause, and imposes no obligation on any party.
verified_facts.basis: Read verbatim from compiled Income Tax Assessment Act 1997, Compilation No. 266, compilation date 1 July 2026.

verified_facts.fact: The term 'RSE licensee' does not appear in the Treasury Laws Amendment (Building a Stronger and Fairer Super System) Act 2026. The Act uses 'superannuation provider' throughout.
verified_facts.basis: Zero matches for 'RSE licensee' against 16 for 'superannuation provider' in the as-made Act text.

verified_facts.fact: s 134-140 of Schedule 1 to the Taxation Administration Act 1953 requires a superannuation provider to notify the Commissioner of the expected payment date of a Division 296 end benefit within 14 days, in the approved form, where the Commissioner keeps a Division 296 debt account for the interest. The section carries an express note that a dissatisfied person may complain under the AFCA scheme.
verified_facts.basis: Read verbatim from the as-made Act.

verified_facts.fact: s 134-145 of Schedule 1 to the Taxation Administration Act 1953 requires a material change or omission in a s 134-140 notice to be corrected within 7 days of the entity becoming aware of it.
verified_facts.basis: Read verbatim from the as-made Act.
